About Us

Property Development & Investment Since 2017

Who We Are

Gloucester Property Group is a property development and investment company. We buy, renovate, and manage our own portfolio of properties across Gloucester and Cheltenham.

We buy run-down and derelict property and turn it into good homes and well-managed spaces, handling every stage in house.

How We Work

We manage every part of the property process in house. That starts with identifying the right property, putting together a solid budget and timeline for renovation, and addressing any planning, financial or legal issues that need to be resolved to make the numbers work.

Once we have ownership, our plans are put into action to carry out the full renovation, managing every trade and every budget decision directly. From there, depending on the project, we either hand the keys back to a landlord or client, or refinance and hold it within our own portfolio. For properties we retain, we handle all ongoing management and maintenance in house.

Our Track Record

With 49 assets across Gloucester and Cheltenham, we have built up a solid track record of buying run-down buildings and turning them into good homes and well-managed spaces.

From HMOs and apartment blocks to specialist and supported accommodation, we have delivered projects across the city that other developers would not take on.

Our Commitment to Gloucester

We are committed to investing in Gloucester and bringing forward projects that contribute positively to the city. Our objective is straightforward: to bring vacant and underutilised properties back into productive use and create spaces that residents can be proud of.

This is our home city, and we are in it for the long term.

What We Do

Three arms, one team. We buy, build and manage our own portfolio across Gloucester and Cheltenham, and everything is handled in house.

Investments

We buy run-down and undervalued property across Gloucester and Cheltenham, often off-market and through lease options, and bring it back into productive use. Every deal is underwritten on real numbers before we commit.

Management

We manage our own portfolio of HMOs, apartment blocks and supported accommodation in house, from tenants and maintenance to the day to day running of every building we hold.

Construction

Our own team carries out the full build on every project, from structural work and extensions through to the final finish. One team, one standard, start to finish.
